# Tempo Productivity Workspace

> Modern, minimal, high-performance task management application featuring a Neo-Brutalist and Carbon & Sage Teal design language, Express REST backend, and Neon PostgreSQL database.

## System Overview
- **Application Name**: Tempo
- **Production URL**: https://tempo-ofxg.onrender.com
- **Repository Context**: Minimal productivity application with structured task tracking, project categorization, and real-time statistics.
- **Architecture**:
  - Frontend: Vanilla JavaScript (ES2022+ modular architecture), CSS custom properties, responsive Neo-Brutalist design system.
  - Backend: Node.js with Express 4, Helmet security headers, compression, and rate limiting.
  - Database: Neon Serverless PostgreSQL with pg-pool and structured relational schemas.
  - Authentication: JWT tokens with bcrypt (10 rounds) password hashing.

## Public Resources
- [Homepage & Workspace](https://tempo-ofxg.onrender.com/): Interactive productivity application and task dashboard.

## Key Capabilities & Privacy Boundaries
- **Ephemeral Guest Mode**: Unauthenticated sessions execute strictly in memory without permanent persistence or database storage. All guest data resets upon browser refresh.
- **Authenticated Workspaces**: Registered accounts receive encrypted PostgreSQL persistence, custom project labels, and secure cross-device task sync.
- **Strict Data Isolation**: Zero cross-account data leakage; row-level tenant enforcement on all CRUD operations.
- **Handcrafted Themes**: High-contrast Neo-Brutalist Light, Dark, Carbon & Sage Teal, and 9 additional multi-theme presets.
